sloka: सीतायाः च विनाशो अयम् मम च अमित्र सूदन ।विस्तरेण जनन्या विनिवेद्य त्वया भवेत् ॥३-६२-१९॥
transliteration: sītāyāḥ ca vināśo ayam mama ca amitra sūdana ।vistareṇa jananyā vinivedya tvayā bhavet ॥3-62-19॥

translations.english: My mother Kaikeyi, Sumitra and Kausalya should also be offered due obeisance. You should protect them with great effort, carrying out my instructions.
